feedback_text: Front desk staff was extremely helpful!
Room service took forever, and the food was cold.
The pool area was clean and well-maintained. Loved the heated water.
Noise from the hallway woke me up at night. Not ideal for business travel.
Breakfast buffet had good variety, but coffee machine was broken.
Wi-Fi was painfully slow, but the manager offered a discount for the trouble.
Housekeeping forgot to refill toiletries on the second day.
Conference rooms were well-equipped, but the projector in room B flickered a lot.
Gym equipment was top-notch and towels were always fresh. Great experience!
Restaurant menu needs more vegetarian options, but staff was very accommodating.
Elevator was out of service for several hours, quite inconvenient.
Check-in process was smooth, and the reception desk remembered my preferences.
I had a billing issue at checkout that took 30 minutes to resolve.
Air conditioning in my room was stuck on max cold, but the technician fixed it quickly.
Lounge bar had a great ambiance, but the cocktails were overpriced.
